visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair lies on a light-colored couch, wearing a tie-dye long-sleeve crop top and gray shorts. She holds a blue smartphone and speaks to the camera with a pleading expression. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of her sitting up, holding the phone which has a colorful beaded strap. A hand from off-screen enters holding a Samsung Galaxy A56 box, which she takes with a surprised, joyful expression. (3) The woman is then seen playing a mobile game on the new phone, pointing at the screen and smiling. A screen recording of the game MapleStory is overlaid momentarily. (4) In another scene, she is lying down and someone feeds her a snack from off-screen while she continues to use the phone. She looks playful and slightly annoyed. (5) She sits on the couch holding a large pack of Tena adult diapers that were handed to her, looking shocked and then laughing. (6) A series of screen captures from the Coupang shopping app are shown, displaying various products like food, vitamins, and smartphones. (7) Finally, she sits with a Coupang delivery box and the diaper pack, giving a thumbs up and smiling widely. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the indoor home setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Female voice opens with a high-pitched, pleading tone and rapid speech, accompanied by a bouncy, light-hearted synthesizer BGM. A percussive 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of the phone box. (2) Male voice enters with an energetic, authoritative delivery, quickly listing brand names. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo. (3) Transition whoosh SFX occurs frequently as scenes cut. Female voice expresses high arousal and joy. (4) Crunching SFX is clearly audible as she bites into a snack. The male voice continues to interact playfully. (5) A dramatic 'bam' or impact SFX triggers the presentation of the diaper pack. Female pitch rises in mock-surprise. (6) Both speakers engage in a fast-paced dialogue about shipping speed, with the music swelling slightly. (7) Technical information about Coupang membership is delivered with clear articulation over a continuous comedic melodic loop. (8) Final stinger SFX ends the audio track abruptly after the last rapid dialogue exchange.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Interaction -> Problem Resolution -> Brand Introduction -> Benefits Summary -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Coupang shopping app and its 618 shopping festival, highlighting fast delivery, genuine product guarantees, and specific tech items like Samsung phones through a comedic boyfriend-girlfriend skit.
